claims.quote: working production brewery inside the pub — 'the unmistakable smells of fermenting malt, hops and yeast'; heart of the historic Distillery District; seasonal beers made on-site
claims.note: PASSES the gate: brews on site, visitable. Macro-owned (Labatt/AB InBev) — ownership is a fact worth surfacing, not a gate. Tourist-scale venue like Steam Whistle.
